name: Dry Creek Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Warm Dry Creek Valley is known for juicy Zinfandel with bright fruit, balanced acidity and notes of blackberry, anise and pepper.
Styles range from high-alcohol to balanced and spicy.
Merlot here tends to show plum, tea leaf and black cherry.

blurb.text: A north-central Sonoma County valley northwest of Healdsburg.
